spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin when price falls below its 200-week moving average and hold long term.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: Asset is BTCUSDT from 'Bitcoin' in claim; timeframe 1d chosen from page chart timeframe because claim names no bar interval and only 1h/4h/1d are available.
200-week moving average approximated as 1400-period SMA of close on daily bars (200*7); SMA assumed to be of close.
Entry 'falls below' / 'drops below' compiled as close crosses_below SMA as a single trigger to match automatic buy-order description, not close simply holding below.
Claim states no exit; assumed long-term hold with max_hold_bars 1825 daily bars (~5 years) to reflect holding March 2020 dip until 2024 as the most common reading for this setup.

evidence.quote: When Bitcoin's price falls below its 200-week moving average
Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today
